name: hunger
description: Physical need or desire to eat or drink.
alternateDefinitions: 'Hunger' can also be used to mean a strong desire of any type, e.g. a hunger for acceptance.
perceptions: I have a hungry feeling in my stomach or feel lightheaded from lack of food.
results: Find a way to get some food

commentaries.quote: There are people in the world so hungry, that God cannot appear to them except in the form of bread.
Bread, soup - these were my whole life. I was a body. Perhaps less than that even: a starved stomach. The stomach alone was aware of the passage of time.
When you're hungry, everything tastes good.
